case_semantics: A FRESH DUAL_ROOT_FANIN DELEGATION CASE IS SOLVED AND INDEPENDENTLY SCORED BY THE EXISTING STRUCTURAL VARIETY ORACLE.
CONCURRENT ROOT TASKS ARE ASSIGNED TO DISTINCT WORKERS BY THE BRAIN DELEGATION SCHEDULER.
EACH SELECTED TASK MATERIALIZES ITS DECLARED EVIDENCE OUTPUT WITH WORKER AND TASK PROVENANCE.
THOSE EXACT DELEGATED EVIDENCE IDS BECOME REQUIRED CLAIMS IN THE EXISTING P3 EVIDENCE_TO_AUDIENCE_SYNTHESIS CONTRACT.
THE P3 BRAIN CANDIDATE MUST SELECT ALL REQUIRED DELEGATED CLAIMS AND PASS THE INDEPENDENT P3 SCORER.
THE ARTIFACT BYTES BIND THE SYNTHESIS HASH, DELEGATION PLAN HASH, SELECTED CLAIMS, AND WORKER/TASK EVIDENCE PROVENANCE.
ABLATING ONE DELEGATED EVIDENCE RECEIPT FROM THE P3 PUBLIC INPUT WHILE KEEPING IT REQUIRED IN THE ORACLE MUST MAKE THE SYNTHESIS SCORER FAIL.
